units.source_text: 内大臣在未知实情以前，对玉鬘的着裳仪式漠不关心。

en.t: Before he learned the truth, the Minister of the Interior showed little concern for Tamakazura's coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 突然知道实情以后，急欲早点看看自己的女儿，等得很不耐烦，所以当天一早就来到了。

en.t: After suddenly learning the truth, he was impatient to see his daughter as soon as possible, so he came early that very morning.

units.source_text: 仪式的排场，比一般规定的更加体面。

en.t: The ceremony was arranged with even greater dignity than the usual rules required.

units.source_text: 内大臣看见源氏太政大臣用心如此周到，觉得深可感谢，同时又觉得有些乖异。

en.t: Seeing how carefully Genji, the Grand Minister, had attended to everything, the Minister of the Interior felt deeply grateful, yet also found it somewhat strange.

units.source_text: 到了亥时，请内大臣进入玉鬘帘内。

en.t: At the Hour of the Boar, the Minister of the Interior was invited inside Tamakazura's curtains.

units.source_text: 规定的设备当然应有尽有；帘内的座位尤为华丽无比。

en.t: All the prescribed furnishings were naturally in place, and the seating inside the curtains was especially splendid beyond compare.

units.source_text: 安排起华筵来，灯火比平常更加明亮，可见招待特别丰盛。

en.t: A splendid banquet had been prepared, the lamps burned brighter than usual, and it was clear that the reception was exceptionally lavish.

units.source_text: 内大臣很想与玉鬘共话，然而今宵太唐突了，未便交谈。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior longed to speak with Tamakazura, but the occasion was too sudden that night, so conversation was not appropriate.

units.source_text: 替她的腰带打结的时候，脸上显出怅惘不堪的神情。

en.t: When he tied the knot of her sash, his face showed an expression of unbearable wistfulness.

units.source_text: 源氏对他说道：“今宵不谈往事，请你装作一概不知的模样。

en.t: Genji said to him, "Tonight, let us not speak of the past; please act as though you know nothing at all.

units.source_text: 为欲掩饰不知实情者的耳目，我们只当作世间普通的着裳仪式可也。”

en.t: To avoid drawing the attention of those who do not know the truth, let us treat this simply as an ordinary coming-of-age ceremony."

units.source_text: 内大臣答道：“承蒙关怀如此周到，无言可以答谢。”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior replied, "You have shown such thoughtful care that I have no words with which to thank you."
Then they raised their cups and drank together.

units.source_text: 内大臣停杯言道：“隆情厚谊，世无其例，使我感谢不尽。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior set down his cup and said, "Such deep kindness and generosity are without equal in the world, and my gratitude is endless.

units.source_text: 惟笼闭至今，一向瞒我，又教我不得不恨啊！”

en.t: Yet keeping her hidden until now and concealing everything from me is something I cannot help but resent."
He then composed a poem, saying:
